<section data-header="Ressources|Communication">
  <div class="panel">
    <h2>Services</h2>
    <ul>
      <li class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1">Ports</li>
      <li class="fragment" data-fragment-index="2">IPs</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
 
  <div class="stage" data-backdrop="still">
    <div class="diagram" data-svg="services"></div>
  </div>
</section>
